svg.aria-label: Authentication: login issues a signed JWT; every later request is checked by Spring Security before reaching a controller
svg.title: Authentication: login issues a signed JWT; every later request is checked by Spring Security before reaching a controller
svg.text: Part 1 — sign in once and receive a token. Part 2 — send the token with every protected request.
same answer in both cases, so nobody can
Part 2 — every request to a protected route (/api/local-pokemon/**)
runs only with a valid token
taken → 409 · else BCrypt hash + save → 201 (no token)
Stateless: no server session, no CSRF cookie needed.
